name: Pirajki SEO
author: Poonam

sections.description:
Pirajki SEO is a comprehensive, professionally engineered WordPress SEO plugin that handles every aspect of on-page and technical SEO automatically, out of the box — with intelligent defaults based on best practices.

Core SEO Features

  • Complete Meta Tag Control — Custom titles, descriptions, robots directives per post/page/term
  • Schema.org JSON-LD — 20+ schema types auto-detected (Article, WebPage, Organization, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Product, Event, Recipe, HowTo, LocalBusiness, and more)
  • XML Sitemaps — Auto-generated with image support, per-content-type sitemaps, auto-ping Google & Bing
  • Open Graph & Twitter Cards — Full social preview control per post with media picker
  • Canonical URLs — Automatic canonical tags, duplicate prevention
  • Redirect Manager — 301/302/307/308 redirects with hit tracking, 404 log with one-click redirect creation
  • Breadcrumbs — Schema-enhanced breadcrumbs via shortcode or action hook
  • Robots.txt — Dynamic robots.txt with AI crawler blocking option
  • Clean WordPress Head — Remove emoji scripts, RSD, WLW, generator tag, oEmbed, shortlinks

Performance Features

  • HTML Minification — Strip whitespace and comments from HTML output
  • Defer JavaScript — Non-blocking JS loading (jQuery excluded)
  • Lazy Load Images & iFrames — Native loading=”lazy” with decoding=”async”
  • LCP Preload — Auto-preload featured images as fetchpriority=”high”
  • Critical CSS — Inline above-the-fold CSS in <head>
  • Browser Cache Headers — Cache-Control, Vary, security headers
  • Security Headers — X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
  • Remove Query Strings — Strip ?ver= from asset URLs
  • Image Quality Control — JPEG/WebP compression quality setting
  • Width/Height Attributes — Auto-add missing image dimensions to prevent CLS

SEO Analysis

  • Live SERP Preview — Real-time Google search result preview in post editor
  • Content Analyzer — Keyword density, readability (Flesch-Kincaid), title/description length, heading structure, internal links, image alt text
  • Per-Post SEO Score — Visual score indicator in post list table
  • Focus Keyword Tracking — Keyword analysis across title, description, content

Admin Dashboard

  • Centralized Dashboard — Feature status overview, quick actions, statistics
  • 8 Settings Pages — On-Page, Technical, Social, Schema, Performance, Redirects, Tools, Advanced
  • Yoast SEO Import — Migrate titles, descriptions, focus keywords, robots, canonical, social and category data plus settings from Yoast in one click
  • AI SEO Meta Integration — AI-generated meta from AI SEO Meta (formerly WP SmartMeta) is used automatically
  • Settings Export — Export/import configuration as JSON
  • REST API — Full REST API for settings and analysis
  • Per-Term SEO — Custom titles and descriptions for categories, tags, custom taxonomies

What Makes Pirajki SEO Different

Unlike other SEO plugins, Pirajki SEO ships with best-practice defaults enabled out of the box — install and it immediately starts improving your SEO without any configuration required. Every feature is engineered for performance with minimal overhead.

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to two external services for sitemap indexing. These calls are only made when you enable the sitemap ping feature in Settings → Technical.

Google Search Console Ping
When a post is published or updated, this plugin may send a request to:
https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=
This notifies Google of your updated sitemap. No personal user data is sent — only your sitemap URL.
* Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Bing Webmaster Tools Ping
When a post is published or updated, this plugin may send a request to:
https://www.bing.com/ping?sitemap=
This notifies Bing of your updated sitemap. No personal user data is sent — only your sitemap URL.
* Bing Terms of Service: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=246338
* Bing Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Both pings are optional and can be disabled in Settings → Technical → Sitemap.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pirajki-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through ‘Plugins’ in WordPress Admin
  3. All best-practice defaults are enabled automatically
  4. Visit Pirajki SEO → Dashboard to review your settings
sections.faq:
Will this conflict with Yoast SEO?

You should deactivate Yoast SEO before using Pirajki SEO. Use Pirajki SEO → Tools → Import from Yoast to migrate your data.

How do I display breadcrumbs?

Add [pirajki_seo_breadcrumbs] shortcode or call do_action('pirajki_seo_breadcrumbs') in your theme.

Where is the sitemap?

Visit yoursite.com/sitemap.xml (this address is also listed in your robots.txt)
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Changed: The sitemap is now at /sitemap.xml. Old addresses (/sitemap-index.xml, /pirajki-seo-sitemap.xml) and the WordPress core sitemap (/wp-sitemap.xml) redirect to it.
  • Fixed: robots.txt pointed to a sitemap address that no longer existed.
  • Fixed: Sitemaps for custom post types returned “not found”.
  • Fixed: Unknown sitemap addresses now return a proper 404 page instead of an empty XML document.
  • Changed: The WordPress core sitemap is turned off while the Pirajki SEO sitemap is enabled, so search engines see only one sitemap.
  • New: Warning on the Technical page when a sitemap.xml or robots.txt file in the site’s root folder would override the plugin.

1.0.3

  • Updated: WP SmartMeta has been renamed AI SEO Meta. The import on the Tools page reads both the new and the old field names.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Yoast SEO import — Yoast variables (%%title%%, %%sep%% …) were imported as literal text; now converted and resolved.
  • Improved: Yoast SEO import now also brings over canonical URLs, nofollow/noarchive/nosnippet/noimageindex, Open Graph and Twitter data, schema type, category/tag SEO data, title formats, separator, social profiles and verification codes.
  • Improved: Imports fill only empty fields by default (optional overwrite), process posts in batches, skip revisions and show a result summary.
  • New: Import from WP SmartMeta, and automatic sync with WP SmartMeta 1.0.1+.
  • New: Title/description variables (%title%, %sep%, %sitename%, %category%, %currentyear% and more) in custom titles, descriptions and social fields.
  • Fixed: Canonical URL override set in the editor was not output.
  • Fixed: Category/tag “Noindex” setting was not output.
  • Fixed: Social profile URLs and verification codes were not saved; Bing/Yandex/Pinterest verification tags used the wrong names.
  • Fixed: “View Sitemap Index” link on the Tools page pointed to a non-existent URL.
  • Fixed: Missing button and notice styling on several settings pages.
  • Fixed: Social, Advanced and Analysis tabs in the post/page editor SEO box did not switch.
  • Fixed: Search Result Preview did not update while editing the SEO title, meta description or the post title.
  • Improved: Content analysis runs automatically — results are ready when you open the Analysis tab and refresh as you edit (no “Run Analysis” click needed).
  • Fixed: Content analysis now reads the current content from both the block editor and the classic editor.
  • Fixed: Twitter card type selection in the editor was not remembered after saving.
  • Improved: Search Result Preview follows your title format setting, live permalink and excerpt/content.
  • Improved: Media picker added for the Twitter image; image previews update instantly.
  • Improved: Editor box scripts and styles moved into their own files and only load on post edit screens.
  • Improved: Editor box strings are now translatable; compatibility with jQuery 4.
  • Security: Analysis results are escaped before display; schema type and Twitter card values are validated on save.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Saving settings on On-Page, Technical, Social, Schema, Performance, and Advanced pages could fail with “Sorry, you are not allowed to access this page” due to a page-identifier mismatch in the settings form.
  • Fixed: Delete button in Redirect Manager was not responding to clicks.
  • Fixed: Several admin AJAX actions (add redirect, delete redirect, clear 404 log, flush sitemap) were not reaching the server due to an internal naming mismatch.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
